role: deterministic development diagnosis, not coverage evidence

registration.role: prospective deterministic development diagnosis, not coverage confirmation
registration.purpose: Isolate the covariance induced by estimating two controls on the same observations before collapsing to matches; diagnose sample-size and control-loading scaling without changing production inference.

design.historical_loadings: Original raw controls, including their worker/firm-index linear components
design.bounded_loadings: Multiply only the worker/firm-index linear components of both controls by 20/k; retain all within-match components. Identical to historical at k=20.
unchanged: target masses, including fixed 1000 multiplier at match (0,0)
true worker and firm effect formulas
design.target_shape_caveat: The fixed 1000 multiplier is not rescaled with G. Record exact leading and remainder concentration at every size; no assumption that growing designs remain q1-eligible.

methods.known_offset: Subtract C gamma, then apply the exact collapsed fixed-offset match-deletion quadratic estimator
methods.estimated_offset: Subtract C gamma_hat from full-sample frequency-weighted joint FE/control least squares, then apply the SAME quadratic estimator
methods.covariance: Original physical-row covariance is block diagonal across matches. Derive the full transformed covariance Omega=S(I-C H_gamma) Sigma (I-C H_gamma)'S', retaining the induced cross-match terms via rank-at-most-four representation.
methods.point_moments: Gaussian exact bias tr(K Omega), variance 4 mu'K Omega K mu + 2 tr(K Omega K Omega)
methods.naive_studentization: Expected exact-trace diagonal-known-tau variance estimator evaluated under each true covariance: 4 mu'K D K mu + 4 tr(K D K Omega) - 2 tr(K D K D). This is not E[SE] and its square root is not a coverage calculation.
methods.q1: Repeat moment diagnosis for the raw leave-out remainder after removing the largest-absolute generalized target eigenmode. Report leading/remainder covariance and exact unweighted target spectral concentration.

verification: Independent physical-row dense WLS and covariance against collapsed low-rank formulas on small fixtures
Dense quadratic-form traces and Gaussian moment identities against factorized formulas
Known offset has zero exact leave-out bias and unbiased exact diagonal-tau variance estimator
Historical and bounded controls coincide at k=20; within-FE control residuals and coefficient covariance are invariant to their FE-loading change
Baseline generated inputs and exact collapsed fit checked against an exported production replay, without tuning to its interval result
New-only manifest and output, exact clean source and file hashes, finite values, complete unique case-target inventory
interpretation_limits: No coverage pass/fail decision, no Monte Carlo calibration, no fit of a replacement variance model
An exact-kernel diagnostic does not include randomized production diagonal or trace error
Population q1 covariance is not a claim about random studentization, interval availability, or q1 limiting-reference quality
This study does not authorize a nuisance correction or public match inference
registration.follow_up: Use this decomposition to register a paired known/estimated-offset by known/fitted-variance simulation if needed, retaining all failures and geometry diagnostics. Full match q0 and fresh observation q1 confirmation remain separate prerequisites for integration.

production_check.comparison: independent exact fit with exported production randomized correction diagonal

limits: No fitted-variance model or random interval calculation was run in this diagnostic.
Known-aggregate-variance studentization uses sqrt(E[Vhat]), not E[SE].
The exact leave-out kernel excludes production randomized-diagonal and trace error.
No production estimator, nuisance correction, or public route was changed.
